title: pre-bilattice
description: An algebra carrying two lattices on one carrier - a truth lattice and a knowledge lattice - and hence two orders. The value structure positing opens, before negation makes it a bilattice.

carrier.description: the shared carrier B both lattices act on

truth-lattice.description: the lattice (B, meet_t, join_t) whose order is the truth order <=_t

knowledge-lattice.description: the lattice (B, meet_k, join_k) whose order is the knowledge order <=_k
